summary: The Copilot adapter's Parse reads the JSON Lines into session/v3 (credits, estimated cost, turns, duration, is_error; no record without a result event); session/v3 and metrics/v3 gain credits and the estimated source; metrics carries credits and marks an estimated cost with ≈.
verified: vloop task gate T3 exited 0 and printed gate T3: ok.
notes: Runner.withSession gives the copilot adapter the session model and copilot.credit-usd (read via config.Get, so file and VLOOP_COPILOT_CREDIT_USD both apply) before Prepare; Parse stays free of config. The ceiling needs no change: spendIn sums cost_usd. The ≈ shows when metrics credits.total > 0. credits.verify is omitempty so a brief without verify keeps no 'verify' text (TestPrintSummaryVerify). session/v3 refuses cost_source estimated for agent claude through an allOf if/then. TestTaskGate* fail only inside a driver session (plan-hash guard), as in T1.
